gloss: to seethe (with anger); to boil with rage

definitions.gloss: to seethe with anger; to boil with rage
definitions.explanation: To be furious inside. Almost always in the set phrase はらわたが{煮|に}えくり{返|かえ}る (one's guts boil over). The literal sense, for a liquid boiling over hard, is rare.

examples.japanese: ⟦はらわた→はらわた：33450_harawata⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{煮|に}えくり{返|かえ}る⟦{思|おも}い→思い：10248_omoi⟧だ。
⟦{親友|しんゆう}→親友：03266_shinyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{裏切|うらぎ}られて→裏切る：02011_uragiru⟧、⟦はらわた→はらわた：33450_harawata⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{煮|に}えくり{返|かえ}った。
examples.english: When my best friend betrayed me, I was boiling with rage.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧{時|とき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{思|おも}い{出|だ}す→思い出す：01258_omoidasu⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧で、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦はらわた→はらわた：33450_harawata⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{煮|に}えくり{返|かえ}る。
examples.english: Just remembering how he acted that time still makes my blood boil.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦はらわた→はらわた：33450_harawata⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{煮|に}えくり{返|かえ}る: to seethe with rage (literally, one's guts boil over)
- ⟦はらわた→はらわた：33450_harawata⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{煮|に}えくり{返|かえ}る⟦{思|おも}い→思い：10248_omoi⟧: a feeling of boiling rage

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{腹|はら}が{立|た}つ→腹が立つ：06886_haragatatsu⟧: to get angry; the everyday phrase
- ⟦{激怒|げきど}→激怒：08681_gekido⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be furious; a written word for an open outburst, where {煮|に}えくり{返|かえ}る is anger felt inside
